topic.title: Variable Scope
topic.description: Three files demonstrating Python scope rules: global vs local, block scope absence, and modifying globals. Covers the LEGB rule in practice.

learningNotes.whatILearned: Understanding the LEGB (Local, Enclosing, Global, Built-in) rule, why Python has no block scope unlike C/Java, and the safest ways to modify global state.
learningNotes.challenges: Accidentally shadowing global variables with local ones and confusion with nested function scopes.
learningNotes.nextSteps: Study the nonlocal keyword and closures for enclosing scope modification.

files.description: Global, enclosing, and local scope illustrations.
Shows Python has no block scope — if/for variables leak out.
Modifying global state safely through function return values.
